::: {#exm-log-sum-exp}

#### Log-sum-exp of the logits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
lse = torch.logsumexp(logits[0], dim=0).item()
largest_logit = logits[0].max().item()
print(lse, largest_logit, largest_logit + np.log(10))
```

For the first test image's [logits](#def-logits), $\operatorname{LSE}$ is `r sprintf("%.3f", py$lse)`,
between the largest [logit](#def-logits), `r sprintf("%.3f", py$largest_logit)`,
and that logit plus $\log 10$.

:::
